title: Building MCP-native hierarchical AI scientist ecosystems: a perspective on scaling multi-agent scientific discovery.
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are evolving from chatbots with limited tool-using capabilities to agentic AI systems that can perform deep research, assist in proposing hypotheses, help design experiments, automate data analysis, and draft scientific reports.
